headline: JNTO figures show British visits to Japan flat in August and up only 5.8% for the year so far.
body: Japan recorded 36,600 UK arrivals in August 2026, down 0.2% on August 2025, and 364,800 for January to August, up 5.8%. Total arrivals to Japan fell 9.6% in August, mainly because visitors from China dropped 59%.
why: After 22% growth in 2025, the UK market is slowing sharply, which matters for anyone planning capacity in Japan travel on last year's trend.
